name: echelon-marketing
description: Forma presentation artifacts for Echelon marketing sites. Every artifact is a single self-contained CSS file with no imports or relative URLs.

artifacts.description: Brand-neutral marketing layer: core tokens, role defaults, Forma foundations, marketing foundations, components, and layouts.
Echelon Marketing Theme: compiled theme tokens and theme hooks. Load after forma-marketing.css.
Single-file Echelon marketing presentation: forma-marketing.css followed by the Echelon theme. Most sites load only this file.
Complete Forma surface (application components, assessment, and marketing layers) for sites that also present Forma application patterns such as data grids or status lozenges.
